name: Dreaming (LanceDB)
description: Light/REM/Deep dreaming for memory-lancedb: narrative DREAMS.md, promotion, and daily report (zero-LLM file summary + optional push to Feishu/WeCom/etc. via dailyReport.delivery).

dreaming_status.description: Check dreaming plugin status, memory stats, and last dream report

dreaming_doctor.description: Self-check the dreaming plugin: hooks, model override, install path, LanceDB slot, cron collision, daily report delivery, and Deep idle streak.

cron.description: Cron expression for the daily deep dreaming run (default: 3am daily)

truthDedupeWindowDays.description: Look back this many days of REM history and skip lasting truths whose TEXT is semantically near an already-surfaced truth

truthSimilarityThreshold.description: Similarity (0-1) at or above which a candidate truth is treated as a repeat of a recent truth and skipped

excludePromoted.description: Skip memories already promoted into MEMORY.md when selecting lasting truths

model.description: Model override for REM semantic theme naming (alias: rem.execution.model)

idleNoveltyAfterDays.description: After this many consecutive zero-promotion days, REM enters novelty mode (tighter dedupe, no stale narrative reuse). Set 0 to disable.

model.description: Model override for narrative generation (falls back to rem.model)

autoManageCron.description: Automatically create and manage the dreaming cron job

pushOn.description: Push when report content changes (changed) or every scheduled run (always)

enabled.label: Enable Dreaming
enabled.help: Turn on automatic memory dreaming (Light/REM/Deep phases)

cron.label: Cron Schedule
cron.help: Cron expression for deep dreaming (e.g. '0 3 * * *' for 3am daily)

autoManageCron.label: Auto-Manage Cron
autoManageCron.help: Let the plugin create and update its cron job automatically

rem.model.label: REM Theme Model
rem.model.help: Provider/model for REM semantic theme naming. Requires plugins.entries.memory-lancedb-dreaming.subagent.allowModelOverride=true and hooks.allowConversationAccess=true.

dailyReport.enabled.label: Daily Report
dailyReport.enabled.help: Publish a zero-LLM daily summary to memory/YYYY-MM-DD.md after dreaming (default: on). Set enabled=false to disable.

dailyReport.cron.label: Daily Report Cron
dailyReport.cron.help: Cron for daily report refresh/delivery (default: 4am, after dreaming cron)

dailyReport.delivery.channel.label: Daily Report Channel
dailyReport.delivery.channel.help: Optional OpenClaw channel for announce delivery (e.g. feishu, telegram)

dailyReport.delivery.to.label: Daily Report Target
dailyReport.delivery.to.help: Delivery target for the configured channel

dailyReport.delivery.pushOn.label: Daily Report Push Policy
dailyReport.delivery.pushOn.help: changed (default): skip IM push when report content is unchanged; always: push every run

narrative.model.label: Narrative Model
narrative.model.help: Provider/model for dream diary narrative. Falls back to rem.model. Requires subagent.allowModelOverride=true.
